chapter: This Is Your Life and film work
title: The surprise voices: nurse Maude Reid and her late teacher
summary: The show brought out her school nurse and her teacher's widowed husband, and she recalls her teacher's death by drowning.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So they would not come, but they showed photos of them and -- anyway, when the show opened up, here I was, singing
"Let's Start the New Year Right, 12:00 O'Clock Tonight," or whatever, and later on -- what's the guy -- I can't even think of his name now.

I get so excited when I talk about it. Ralph Edwards came out and said, yes, yes, yes, something, we're going to have fun tonight. And then here comes a voice saying, "It's been a long time, Nellie Lutcher --," something, "since I looked down your throat in Lake Charles, Louisiana," or something. Then it hit me and I sat there and I looked and I looked, and I thought what is this voice coming from some foreign place, you know. And I looked and looked, and then finally she said, yes, and I think it was the first person they brought out, and that was Maude Reid, who was a nurse at the school where I went.

At your now famous throat, or your now famous tonsils, or something like that, she said, and she came walking out on the stage. Well, I tell you, that was the beginning. And then they brought so many surprises out. You know the nature of the show.

They brought the principal, who was my music teacher's -- my music teacher had gone on. I didn't bring that up later. It was my music teacher who I loved so dearly and who was so wonderful to me, and so interested in me and my career, and I

just give her all the credit in the world for helping to steer me on and to train me. Well, she got drowned. She was in a terrible automobile accident, she and her husband's mother. Let's see, was it she and her husband's mother? No, she and her neice. There were four of them in the car. She and her neice were drowned, and the husband and the husband's mother survived. But that was a terrible thing.

But anyway, the husband came. They got him. He was the principal of the school and they got him to come, and each -- you know the nature of the show -- each one of these people would speak out something, you'd recognize his voice, and I would just go to pieces every time I would hear a voice.
